assets.rightsBasis: Official TEC header lock-up served from the college's own domain (tagore-engg.ac.in, site-wide header). No open licence; used only to identify the institution. Checked 2026-10-26: HTTP 200, image/png, 86,626 bytes, 2772x500 px, sha256 45e873d50129ba5fbc6456f2f591817a696ec06f7f2035bb36ae32d6f8609043. Rendered on white and visually confirmed legible: maroon shield crest reading 'Tagore Engineering College' and 'Labour to Glory', maroon wordmark 'TAGORE ENGINEERING COLLEGE', and two navy lines (AICTE/NBA/Anna University affiliation and the Rathinamangalam address). CAVEAT: wide banner; the 'Accredited by NBA' line describes programme, not institutional, accreditation. Rejected: logo2/logo3/logo4.png and actual/college-logo.png (100 px icons).

Official campus photograph from the home-page gallery on the college's own domain. No open licence; used only to depict the institution. Checked 2026-10-26: HTTP 200, image/jpeg, 233,240 bytes, 500x400 px, sha256 091904dd279e829b9b64ab4089580e3c941021791722ca1dc255312b600d7f21. Visually confirmed as a single real photograph, not a composite or AI image: wide view of the machine shop with lathes and a radial drilling machine under a steel-truss roof; students are at mid or far distance, none in close-up; no text overlay or watermark. CAVEAT: low resolution (500x400) and an interior workshop view; the site publishes no exterior building photograph. Rejected: pic1.jpg (award banner with text and identifiable people), tagore-web.png (conference banner), tec-gallery-3 to 6 (event photos of identifiable people), tg8.jpg (students posed in a line in front of an aircraft), tg2/tg3/tg4/tg12 (closer student shots).
